title: Waltzing Matilda
source: Words by A. B. "Banjo" Paterson (1895; d. 1941) as altered for Marie Cowan's setting, published by James Inglis & Co., Sydney, 1903 (Cowan d. 1919): the Cowan text only (troopers, the third line repeated in the chorus, "You'll never catch me alive"), checked against the "Marie Cowan version" text at ausemade.com.au. Not Paterson's 1895 manuscript words and not any later arrangement: Carl Fischer's US copyright (1941) covers only its own arrangement, which is not used here. Chords are an original, simple setting.
license: Public domain (Paterson d. 1941, Cowan d. 1919, published 1903); chord arrangement original, CC0
